Post eum ædificávit Hananía fílius Selemíæ , et Hanun fílius Seleph sextus , mensúram secúndam : post eum ædificávit Mosóllam fílius Barachíæ , contra gazophylácium suum .

traditions.KJV: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith ’s son

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἕως ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς καμπῆς .
traditions.VUL: et usque ad cœnáculum ánguli .
traditions.KJV: and to the going up of the corner .

32.english_reference: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate

traditions.WLC: וּ בֵ֨ין עֲלִיַּ֤ת הַ פִּנָּה֙ לְ שַׁ֣עַר הַ צֹּ֔אן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον ἀναβάσεως τῆς πύλης τῆς προβατικῆς
traditions.VUL: Et inter cœnáculum ánguli in porta gregis
traditions.KJV: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate

32.english_reference: repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants .

traditions.WLC: הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַ צֹּרְפִ֖ים וְ הָ רֹכְלִֽים
traditions.LXX: ἐκράτησαν οἱ χαλκεῖς καὶ οἱ ῥοβοπῶλαι .
traditions.VUL: ædificavérunt aurífices et negotiatóres .
traditions.KJV: repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants .

33.english_reference: But it came to pass , that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֞י כַּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר שָׁמַ֣ע סַנְבַלַּ֗ט כִּֽי אֲנַ֤חְנוּ בוֹנִים֙ אֶת הַ֣ חוֹמָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Factum est autem , cum audísset Sanabállat quod ædificarémus murum ,
traditions.KJV: But it came to pass , that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall ,

33.english_reference: he was wroth , and took great indignation ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֣חַר ל֔ וֹ וַ יִּכְעַ֖ס הַרְבֵּ֑ה
traditions.VUL: irátus est valde : et motus nimis
traditions.KJV: he was wroth , and took great indignation ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּלְעֵ֖ג עַל הַ יְּהוּדִֽים
traditions.VUL: subsannávit Iudǽos ,
traditions.KJV: and mocked the Jews .

34.english_reference: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר לִ פְנֵ֣י אֶחָ֗י ו וְ חֵיל֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן
traditions.VUL: et dixit coram frátribus suis , et frequéntia Samaritanórum :
traditions.KJV: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria ,

34.english_reference: and said , What do these feeble Jews ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֛ה הַ יְּהוּדִ֥ים הָ אֲמֵלָלִ֖ים עֹשִׂ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Quid Iudǽi fáciunt imbecílles ?
traditions.KJV: and said , What do these feeble Jews ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ יַעַזְב֨וּ לָ הֶ֤ם
traditions.VUL: num dimíttent eos gentes ?
traditions.KJV: will they fortify themselves ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ יִזְבָּ֨חוּ֙
traditions.VUL: num sacrificábunt ,
traditions.KJV: will they sacrifice ?

34.english_reference: will they make an end in a day ?

traditions.WLC: הַ יְכַלּ֣וּ בַ יּ֔וֹם
traditions.VUL: et complébunt in una die ?
traditions.KJV: will they make an end in a day ?

34.english_reference: will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?

traditions.WLC: הַ יְחַיּ֧וּ אֶת הָ אֲבָנִ֛ים מֵ עֲרֵמ֥וֹת הֶ עָפָ֖ר וְ הֵ֥מָּה שְׂרוּפֽוֹת
traditions.VUL: numquid ædificáre póterunt lápides de acérvis púlveris , qui combústi sunt ?
traditions.KJV: will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?

35.english_reference: Now Tobiah the Ammonite [ was ] by him ,

traditions.VUL: Sed et Tobías Ammanítes , próximus eius ,
traditions.KJV: Now Tobiah the Ammonite [ was ] by him ,

traditions.VUL: ait : Ædíficent :
traditions.KJV: and he said , Even that which they build ,

35.english_reference: if a fox go up , he shall even break down their stone wall .

traditions.WLC: אִם יַעֲלֶ֣ה שׁוּעָ֔ל וּ פָרַ֖ץ חוֹמַ֥ת אַבְנֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: si ascénderit vulpes , transíliet murum eórum lapídeum .
traditions.KJV: if a fox go up , he shall even break down their stone wall .

36.english_reference: Hear , O our God ; for we are despised :

traditions.WLC: שְׁמַ֤ע אֱלֹהֵ֨י נוּ֙ כִּֽי הָיִ֣ינוּ בוּזָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Audi Deus noster , quia facti sumus despéctui :
traditions.KJV: Hear , O our God ; for we are despised :

36.english_reference: and turn their reproach upon their own head ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הָשֵׁ֥ב חֶרְפָּתָ֖ ם אֶל רֹאשָׁ֑ ם
traditions.VUL: convérte oppróbrium super caput eórum ,
traditions.KJV: and turn their reproach upon their own head ,

36.english_reference: and give them for a prey in the land of captivity :

traditions.WLC: וּ תְנֵ֥ ם לְ בִזָּ֖ה בְּ אֶ֥רֶץ שִׁבְיָֽה
traditions.VUL: et da eos in despectiónem in terra captivitátis .
traditions.KJV: and give them for a prey in the land of captivity :

traditions.WLC: וְ אַל תְּכַס֙ עַל עֲוֺנָ֔ ם
traditions.VUL: Ne opérias iniquitátem eórum ,
traditions.KJV: And cover not their iniquity ,

traditions.KJV: for they have provoked [ thee ] to anger before the builders .

traditions.VUL: Itaque ædificávimus murum ,
traditions.KJV: So built we the wall ;

traditions.KJV: for the people had a mind to work .
